sourceMorphology: White tall central spire, two raised lateral horns, and a broad base with three low scallops.
discriminatingFeature: The source has the lander crop’s distinctive symmetric spire-and-two-horns outer contour and scalloped base; it lacks the intruder crop’s circular curled body, toothed inner arc, eye holes, and dorsal spines.
internalMarkNote: The source card variant does not visibly retain the glossary crop’s small dark vertical slit at this raster size; identity rests on the otherwise distinctive matching outer contour, not rule semantics.
